name: +1 Speed Squid Escape 🦑
desc:
Welcome To +1 Speed Squid Escape 🦑

❓  HOW TO PLAY: ❓
💪 Train your speed and stamina to escape from the games!
🏃‍♂️ Run, dodge, and escape through obstacles!
💰 Earn cash with each reached checkpoint
📊 Upgrade your stats, rebirth, and become unstoppable!


⚡ Get faster and FASTER to beat every game and become the ultimate escapee!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and prove you're #1!
🎮 Can you survive all ten games and ESCAPE?

👍 Like & Favorite the game to support updates!
🔔 Join our group for rewards and game news!
